moto-gloves-pow.name: ★ Moto Gloves | POW!
moto-gloves-pow.desc: These bulky hard knuckled gloves can protect the wearers hands from road rash at 60 mph. This pair has been covered in brightly colored comic book onomatopoeia.

bloodhound-gloves-charred.name: ★ Bloodhound Gloves | Charred
bloodhound-gloves-charred.desc:
These fingerless gloves have been decorated with metal studs and the Operation Bloodhound logo. It was crafted out of classic black supple leather.

Challenge coins are great, but they don't draw blood when you backfist someone - Carmen Cocinero, Extraction Expert

aug-sweeper.name: AUG | Sweeper
aug-sweeper.desc:
Powerful and accurate, the AUG scoped assault rifle compensates for its long reload times with low spread and a high rate of fire. It has been spray painted with a brown, grey, and red mesh pattern.

Clear a path

awp-asiimov.name: AWP | Asiimov
awp-asiimov.desc:
High risk and high reward, the infamous AWP is recognizable by its signature report and one-shot, one-kill policy. It has been custom painted with a sci-fi design.

Anyone can predict the future... a visionary shapes it

awp-wildfire.name: AWP | Wildfire
awp-wildfire.desc:
High risk and high reward, the infamous AWP is recognizable by its signature report and one-shot, one-kill policy. The Operation Wildfire logo has been hand painted over a black and red base.

The nail that sticks out gets the hammer

awp-electric-hive.name: AWP | Electric Hive
awp-electric-hive.desc: High risk and high reward, the infamous AWP is recognizable by its signature report and one-shot, one-kill policy. It has been painted using a hexagon patterned hydrographic.

awp-exothermic.name: AWP | Exothermic
awp-exothermic.desc:
High risk and high reward, the infamous AWP is recognizable by its signature report and one-shot, one-kill policy. A red-colored burst pattern has been applied.

"Cool guys don't look at explosions"

pp-bizon-night-ops.name: PP-Bizon | Night Ops
pp-bizon-night-ops.desc:
The Bizon SMG is low-damage, but offers a uniquely designed high-capacity drum magazine that reloads quickly. It has been painted using a VariCamo patterned hydrographic.

Rebuilding only comes in the wake of destruction

desert-eagle-the-bronze.name: Desert Eagle | The Bronze
desert-eagle-the-bronze.desc:
As expensive as it is powerful, the Desert Eagle is an iconic pistol that is difficult to master but surprisingly accurate at long range. A multicolored pattern of randomized numbers has been applied.

Numbers don't lie, but I do

desert-eagle-pilot.name: Desert Eagle | Pilot
desert-eagle-pilot.desc:
As expensive as it is powerful, the Desert Eagle is an iconic pistol that is difficult to master but surprisingly accurate at long range. It has a brass inlay of a pilot's wings.

Assume crash positions

dual-berettas-hydro-strike.name: Dual Berettas | Hydro Strike
dual-berettas-hydro-strike.desc:
Firing two large-mag Berettas at once will lower accuracy and increase load times. On the bright side, you'll get to fire two large-mag Berettas at once. It has been custom painted in blue and orange. The droplets imply the weapons may still be wet.

The best weapon is the one your enemies least expect

dual-berettas-contractor.name: Dual Berettas | Contractor
dual-berettas-contractor.desc:
Firing two large-mag Berettas at once will lower accuracy and increase load times. On the bright side, you'll get to fire two large-mag Berettas at once. It has individual parts spray-painted tan, navy and dark green.

Rona Sabri still hasn't forgiven Sebastien for not selecting her to go after Turner

g3sg1-the-executioner.name: G3SG1 | The Executioner
g3sg1-the-executioner.desc:
The pricy G3SG1 lowers movement speed considerably but compensates with a higher rate of fire than other sniper rifles. It has been hand painted with a gruesome display of bone.

I always take a trophy - Javier Alviso, Fist of the Phoenix

glock-18-rameses-reach.name: Glock-18 | Ramese's Reach
glock-18-rameses-reach.desc:
The Glock 18 is a serviceable first-round pistol that works best against unarmored opponents and is capable of firing three-round bursts. The Nile river has been custom painted on the slide and the grip depicts Ramesses I, the founding pharaoh of ancient Egypt's 19th Dynasty.

"My people reach for their Gods, and I am here to connect them"

p2000-corticera.name: P2000 | Corticera
p2000-corticera.desc: Accurate and controllable, the German-made P2000 is a serviceable first-round pistol that works best against unarmored opponents. It has has been painted with a corticera tree motif.

p2000-grassland-leaves.name: P2000 | Grassland Leaves
p2000-grassland-leaves.desc: Accurate and controllable, the German-made P2000 is a serviceable first-round pistol that works best against unarmored opponents. It has been spray-painted using leaves as stencils.

butterfly-knife-doppler-black-pearl.name: ★ Butterfly Knife | Doppler
butterfly-knife-doppler-black-pearl.desc:
This is a custom-designed balisong, commonly known as a butterfly knife. The defining characteristic of this weapon is the fan-like opening of a freely pivoting blade, allowing rapid deployment or concealment. As a result, butterfly knives are outlawed in many countries. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

Getting lost in its color can prove fatal

butterfly-knife-doppler-phase-4.name: ★ Butterfly Knife | Doppler
butterfly-knife-doppler-phase-4.desc:
This is a custom-designed balisong, commonly known as a butterfly knife. The defining characteristic of this weapon is the fan-like opening of a freely pivoting blade, allowing rapid deployment or concealment. As a result, butterfly knives are outlawed in many countries. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

Getting lost in its color can prove fatal

survival-knife-night-stripe.name: ★ Survival Knife | Night Stripe
survival-knife-night-stripe.desc:
This multi-purpose tactical knife features a serrated edge for ripping through coarse material like bone or fiber, plus a sharp gutting hook. The composite material handle is bolted to the blade with hex nuts. It has been spray-painted with a tape mask pattern in a night ops color scheme.

Spray... Pray... Paint... Stab.

falchion-knife-tiger-tooth.name: ★ Falchion Knife | Tiger Tooth
falchion-knife-tiger-tooth.desc:
A modern homage to a falchion sword, this clip point blade has a curved edge. It has been anodized orange and hand-etched in a tiger stripe pattern.

Like the tiger it is rare... like the tiger it is deadly...

falchion-knife-lore.name: ★ Falchion Knife | Lore
falchion-knife-lore.desc: A modern homage to a falchion sword, this clip point blade has a curved edge. It has been custom painted with knotwork.

gut-knife-autotronic.name: ★ Gut Knife | Autotronic
gut-knife-autotronic.desc: The most notable feature of a gut knife is the gut hook on the spine of the blade.  Originally popularized as an aid for field dressing game, the gut hook is also effective at  cutting through fibrous materials like rope, webbing, or safety belts with ease. It has been anodized red and uses steel mesh to lighten the weight.

navaja-knife-doppler-sapphire.name: ★ Navaja Knife | Doppler
navaja-knife-doppler-sapphire.desc:
This marble-enamel-handled flip knife conceals a small but viciously tapered blade. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

Getting lost in its color can prove fatal

karambit-doppler-phase-2.name: ★ Karambit | Doppler
karambit-doppler-phase-2.desc:
With its curved blade mimicking a tiger's claw, the karambit was developed as part of the southeast Asian martial discipline of silat. The knife is typically used with a reverse grip, with the finger ring on the index finger. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

Getting lost in its color can prove fatal

karambit-gamma-doppler-emerald.name: ★ Karambit | Gamma Doppler
karambit-gamma-doppler-emerald.desc: With its curved blade mimicking a tiger's claw, the karambit was developed as part of the southeast Asian martial discipline of silat. The knife is typically used with a reverse grip, with the finger ring on the index finger. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

karambit-gamma-doppler-phase-2.name: ★ Karambit | Gamma Doppler
karambit-gamma-doppler-phase-2.desc: With its curved blade mimicking a tiger's claw, the karambit was developed as part of the southeast Asian martial discipline of silat. The knife is typically used with a reverse grip, with the finger ring on the index finger. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

karambit-doppler-ruby.name: ★ Karambit | Doppler
karambit-doppler-ruby.desc:
With its curved blade mimicking a tiger's claw, the karambit was developed as part of the southeast Asian martial discipline of silat. The knife is typically used with a reverse grip, with the finger ring on the index finger. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

Getting lost in its color can prove fatal

nomad-knife-doppler-sapphire.name: ★ Nomad Knife | Doppler
nomad-knife-doppler-sapphire.desc:
This ergonomic tactical hunting lock-blade knife features composite handle inserts and a broad, sturdy blade, useful for cutting and prying apart material. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

Getting lost in its color can prove fatal

stiletto-knife-tiger-tooth.name: ★ Stiletto Knife | Tiger Tooth
stiletto-knife-tiger-tooth.desc:
Historically a focal point of contention and even regulation, this Italian-style stiletto switchblade knife features a spring-loaded blade that can be deployed almost instantly with the push of a release catch. It has been anodized orange and hand-etched in a tiger stripe pattern.

Like the tiger it is rare... like the tiger it is deadly...

bowie-knife-fade.name: ★ Bowie Knife | Fade
bowie-knife-fade.desc:
This full-tang sawback Bowie knife is designed for heavy use in brutal survival situations. It has been painted by airbrushing transparent paints that fade together over a chrome base coat.

This isn't just a weapon, it's a conversation piece - Imogen, Arms Dealer In Training

bowie-knife-rust-coat.name: ★ Bowie Knife | Rust Coat
bowie-knife-rust-coat.desc:
This full-tang sawback Bowie knife is designed for heavy use in brutal survival situations. This memento from Siege is still perfectly operational although the exterior surfaces have rusted.

Scars build character

bowie-knife-crimson-web.name: ★ Bowie Knife | Crimson Web
bowie-knife-crimson-web.desc:
This full-tang sawback Bowie knife is designed for heavy use in brutal survival situations. It has been painted using a spider web-patterned hydrographic over a red base coat and finished with a semi-gloss topcoat.

Be careful where you walk, you never know where the web is spread

bowie-knife-urban-masked.name: ★ Bowie Knife | Urban Masked
bowie-knife-urban-masked.desc:
This full-tang sawback Bowie knife is designed for heavy use in brutal survival situations. It has been spray-painted using a tangle of masking tape as a stencil.

True power is demonstrated with subtle application

huntsman-knife-doppler-phase-1.name: ★ Huntsman Knife | Doppler
huntsman-knife-doppler-phase-1.desc:
A knife designed for modern tactical uses, the blade is well suited for a range of both combat and utilitarian needs.  The unique Tanto point allows for maximum penetration through even the toughest of surfaces. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

Getting lost in its color can prove fatal

talon-knife-stained.name: ★ Talon Knife | Stained
talon-knife-stained.desc:
This ivory-handled karambit features brass rivets and saw-tooth ridges, so it cuts on the way in, and tears on the way out. It has been given a forced patina using lemon and mustard dripped onto the surface.

If you think it's messy now, wait until you see it under a blacklight

talon-knife-case-hardened.name: ★ Talon Knife | Case Hardened
talon-knife-case-hardened.desc:
This ivory-handled karambit features brass rivets and saw-tooth ridges, so it cuts on the way in, and tears on the way out. It has been color case-hardened through the application of wood charcoal at high temperatures.

A little color never hurt anyone

mag-7-counter-terrace.name: MAG-7 | Counter Terrace
mag-7-counter-terrace.desc:
The CT-exclusive Mag-7 delivers a devastating amount of damage at close range. Its rapid magazine-style reloads make it a great tactical choice. It has been painted with a hydrographic in a geometric motif.

Hey Sabri, you should take this one... it's loud like you - Carmen Cocinero, Extraction Expert

mag-7-memento.name: MAG-7 | Memento
mag-7-memento.desc: The CT-exclusive Mag-7 delivers a devastating amount of damage at close range. Its rapid magazine-style reloads make it a great tactical choice. It has been painted using a geometric-patterned hydrographic.

mp5-sd-savannah-halftone.name: MP5-SD | Savannah Halftone
mp5-sd-savannah-halftone.desc:
Often imitated but never equaled, the iconic MP5 is perhaps the most versatile and popular SMG in the world. This SD variant features an integrated silencer, making an already formidable weapon whisper-quiet. It has been custom painted using a sand and olive-colored halftone design.

Observe in silence, then make yourself known

mp9-food-chain.name: MP9 | Food Chain
mp9-food-chain.desc:
Manufactured in Switzerland, the cutting-edge MP9 SMG is an ergonomic polymer weapon favored by private security firms. This brightly colored MP9 has been custom painted with a monster food chain.

Eat or be eaten

negev-wall-bang.name: Negev | Wall Bang
negev-wall-bang.desc:
The Negev is a beast that can keep the enemy at bay with its pin-point supressive fire, provided you have the luxury of time to gain control over it. Its crimson base has been tagged with graffiti from different artists.

Hold it down

nova-wurst-holle.name: Nova | Wurst Hölle
nova-wurst-holle.desc:
The Nova's rock-bottom price tag makes it a great ambush weapon for a cash-strapped team. It has been custom painted using sausages from Wurst Hölle, the biergarten on Overpass.

Look no further, you've found the missing link

p250-black-tan.name: P250 | Black & Tan
p250-black-tan.desc:
A low-recoil firearm with a high rate of fire, the P250 is a relatively inexpensive choice against armored opponents. A black and tan-colored multicam hydrographic has been applied.

Can't miss if you don't shoot

p90-schematic.name: P90 | Schematic
p90-schematic.desc:
Easily recognizable for its unique bullpup design, the P90 is a great weapon to shoot on the move due to its high-capacity magazine and low recoil. A multicolored pattern of an isometric grid has been applied.

You remember pain, I remember victory

sawed-off-zander.name: Sawed-Off | Zander
sawed-off-zander.desc:
The classic Sawed-Off deals very heavy close-range damage, but with its low accuracy, high spread and slow rate of fire, you'd better kill what you hit. It has been hand painted to resemble a popular game fish.

This one's a keeper

scar-20-bloodsport.name: SCAR-20 | Bloodsport
scar-20-bloodsport.desc:
The SCAR-20 is a semi-automatic sniper rifle that trades a high rate of fire and powerful long-distance damage for sluggish movement speed and big price tag. It has been covered in white logo decals over a red and black hydrographic.

CT-side sponsored by…

scar-20-sirocco-script.name: SCAR-20 | Sirocco Script
scar-20-sirocco-script.desc:
The SCAR-20 is a semi-automatic sniper rifle that trades a high rate of fire and powerful long-distance damage for sluggish movement speed and big price tag. A decorative pattern of pseudo-calligraphy and arabesque geometry has been applied.

Shaped through heat, dust, and dry winds

sg-553-dragon-tech.name: SG 553 | Dragon Tech
sg-553-dragon-tech.desc:
The terrorist-exclusive SG553 is a premium scoped alternative to the AK47 for effective long-range engagement. It has been custom painted with a biomechanical green dragon.

That's not my dragon…

sg-553-safari-print.name: SG 553 | Safari Print
sg-553-safari-print.desc:
The terrorist-exclusive SG553 is a premium scoped alternative to the AK47 for effective long-range engagement. A brown animal print pattern has been applied.

You said "a few animals", not "the entire animal kingdom"

ssg-08-deaths-head.name: SSG 08 | Death's Head
ssg-08-deaths-head.desc:
The SSG08 bolt-action is a low-damage but very cost-effective sniper rifle, making it a smart choice for early-round long-range marksmanship. It has been hand painted to resemble a death's-head hawkmoth.

Quid pro quo

tec-9-blast-from-the-past.name: Tec-9 | Blast From the Past
tec-9-blast-from-the-past.desc:
An ideal pistol for the Terrorist on the move, the Tec-9 is lethal in close quarters and features a high magazine capacity. A pale green and beige pattern of ancient tiles has been applied.

"Hope remains, even for those began their journey down the wrong path"

ump-45-blaze.name: UMP-45 | Blaze
ump-45-blaze.desc: The misunderstood middle child of the SMG family, the UMP45's small magazine is the only drawback to an otherwise versatile close-quarters automatic. It has been painted by airbrushing transparent paints over a chrome base coat.

flip-knife.name: ★ Flip Knife
flip-knife.desc: Flip knives sport a Persian-style back-swept blade with an acute point.  While the point itself may be fragile, the overall design of the flip knife's design is surprisingly durable.
